textPool.name: bountyClues
textPool.entry: Torn Pack|Fresh claw marks and a torn pack - {target} passed here not long ago.
Half-Eaten Carcass|A half-eaten carcass. {target} is close, and still hungry.
Deep Tracks|Tracks, deep and heavy, lead away into the wilds. The radar shows where.
Broken Arrows|Broken arrows, and no archer left to fire them. {target} doesn't leave survivors.
Wrecked Camp|A hunter's camp, wrecked. Whoever slept here didn't wake up.

textPool.name: kidnapClues
textPool.entry: Torn Ribbon|A torn ribbon caught on a thorn - {hostage} came this way.
Drag Marks|Boot prints, several of them, and drag marks. They are not far.
Gang Token|A dropped token of {gang}. So that is who took {hostage}.
Warm Ashes|Ashes of a campfire, still warm. The trail goes on.
Lost Shoe|A shoe, trampled into the mud. {hostage} fought them.

textPool.name: expeditionClues
textPool.entry: Broken Surveyor's Rod|A broken surveyor's rod, stamped with the mark of {expedition}.
Journal Page|A journal page: "...the beasts came at night, we ran north..."
Abandoned Camp|An abandoned camp. The tents are slashed, the fire long cold.
Bloodied Rocks|Blood on the rocks, and a trail of dropped supplies.
Signal Flag|A signal flag, planted in haste. Someone wanted to be found.
Snapped Chain|A surveyor's chain, snapped clean in two. Something strong did this.

textPool.name: fugitives
textPool.entry: Corran the Deserter
Vessa Two-Knives
Brother Malek the Defrocked
Haldric the Turncoat
Ilsa Blackmantle
Teodor the Poisoner

textPool.entry: the Saltwind Runners
the Night Barrow Gang
the Iron Purse Smugglers
the Ashroad Traders

textPool.name: children
textPool.entry: little Pim
young Ada
the twins' brother Lowe
little Mira
young Bastian

textPool.name: rareBeasts
textPool.entry: the White Hart of the Hollows
Old Silvermane
the Ember-Eyed Boar
the Thornback Matriarch
the Ghost Lynx

textPool.name: treasureClues
textPool.entry: Here! The ground is soft and freshly turned - someone buried something.
The landmarks match the map. Dig here.

textPool.name: manhuntClues
textPool.entry: Frightened Farmer|A farmer saw {fugitive} pass by at dawn, heading into the wilds.
Bloodied Cloak|A bloodied cloak, left behind in haste. The trail goes on.
Cold Camp|A cold camp and a stolen purse. {fugitive} is close.
Nervous Merchant|A merchant swears {fugitive} paid him in stolen coin an hour ago.

textPool.name: beastTracks
textPool.entry: Huge Tracks|Huge tracks, pressed deep into the earth. It passed here.
Torn Bark|Torn bark, high up on a tree. It is bigger than you thought.
Fresh Droppings|Fresh droppings. It isn't far now.
Tuft of Fur|A tuft of {beast}'s fur caught on a thorn.

textPool.name: childClues
textPool.entry: Small Shoe|A small shoe, lost in the grass. {child} came this way.
Crying in the Woods|Someone heard crying from the woods over there.
Dropped Doll|A doll, dropped by the path. The tracks go on.
Half-Eaten Apple|A half-eaten apple, still fresh. Little teeth marks.
Ribbon on a Branch|Someone tied a ribbon to a branch here - a child's way of not getting lost.

textPool.name: scoutLines
textPool.entry: From up here you can see their camps. You note them down.
You count their fires and watch the patrols change.
A good view of the passes. The board will want this.

textPool.name: watchLines
textPool.entry: All quiet at this post. On to the next.
Something moves out there in the dark...
The torch at this post had gone out. You light it again.

textPool.name: caravanChatter
textPool.entry: Mind the left wheel, it's been squealing since Giran.
Twenty years on these roads, and I still hate this stretch.
If the cargo arrives dry, there's a bottle in it for you. Maybe two.
Hear that? ...No. Just the wind. Keep going.
The last escort we hired ran at the first arrow. You won't, will you?
Easy now, the horses don't like the smell of this place.
The guild says this road is safe. The guild doesn't ride it.

textPool.name: captiveChatter
textPool.entry: They kept talking about someone they called the boss. I never saw a face.
Please, not so fast... my legs are still shaking.
I kept thinking nobody would come. Thank you for coming.
Every shadow looks like one of them. Is that one of them?
When we're home, I'm never taking this road again.
They argued about selling me. I don't want to know to whom.

textPool.name: survivorChatter
textPool.entry: We heard it before we saw it. Then the screaming started.
I still have the maps. Someone should finish what we started.
Water... no, keep going. I can drink in town.
The others ran north. I ran the wrong way, and lived.
Don't let me fall asleep. I see their faces when I close my eyes.
The Ivory Tower will want a report. They always want a report.

textPool.name: childChatter
textPool.entry: I wasn't scared. Well... maybe a little.
Is mama angry? She's going to be angry.
I followed a butterfly. A really big one.
Can you teach me to fight like that?
My feet hurt. Are we nearly there?
I heard wolves. Real ones! Did you hear them?

textPool.name: guildClues
textPool.entry: Chalk Marker|A guild marker, chalked on a stone. The next one should be further on.
Notched Tree|Notches cut into a tree trunk - the guild's sign for "keep going".
Hidden Note|A sealed note under a rock: "Further out. Watch your back."
Scratched Marker|The marker is here, but someone tried to scratch it out. Interesting.

textPool.name: captureBeasts
textPool.entry: the Silver-Horned Stag
the Moonfur Wolf
the Ironhide Bull
the Gilded Lynx
the Ashback Boar

textPool.name: hideoutClues
textPool.entry: Lookout Post|An empty lookout post, still warm. Someone left in a hurry - towards their hideout.
Stolen Goods|A cache of stolen goods with the mark of {gang}. They'll be back for it.
Beaten Merchant|A beaten merchant points the way: "Their leader rides with them. Go!"
Fresh Hoofprints|Fresh hoofprints and the stub of a cigar. The leader's, by the smell of it.

textPool.name: beastTaunts
textPool.entry: *A low growl rolls out of the undergrowth.*
*{target} sniffs the air - it has your scent.*
*Something heavy crashes through the brush, then goes quiet.*
*{target} lets out a howl that makes the birds scatter.*

textPool.name: gangTaunts
textPool.entry: You'll never see your precious captive again!
Another hero? We eat heroes for breakfast.
Turn back while you still have legs to walk on.
The boss pays double for every head. Come closer.

textPool.name: fugitiveTaunts
textPool.entry: The board sent you? They must really want me dead.
I've killed better than you for less.
Go home, hunter. There's no bounty worth your life.
I know these woods. You don't.

textPool.name: rivalTaunts
textPool.entry: Back off - this bounty's ours!
Find your own monster, amateur.
We were here first. Don't make this ugly.

template.name: Wanted: {target}

contact.dialog: So the board sent you. {target} tore through a camp here at dawn - two of my men won't see another sunrise. Its trail starts close by and it is still warm. Find it before it goes cold.
contact.line: Good hunting. Don't let it get behind you.

stage.name: The Last Sighting
stage.text: {target} was last seen in {place}. Search the place on your radar for its trail.
Your tracker points the way: {target} came through {place} at dawn. Find where it went.

on.text: The trail has gone cold.

stage.name: The Hunt
stage.text: The trail leads on. {target} is somewhere ahead - follow the radar and finish it.
The trail is clear now. {target} isn't far - and it knows it is being hunted.

objective.fleeText: {target} caught your scent and fled! Follow the radar.

on.text: Among the remains: a token of {gang}. There will be more of them.
{target} has slipped away to a new lair! You have one more chance.

template.text: Wanted
A beast of the wilds has grown bold and killed travellers near the roads. The board pays well for its head. Its trail starts in the hunting grounds of your strength.
Three caravans lost on the same stretch of road, and the hunters who went after the beast never came back. The board has doubled the bounty. A tracker waits where it was last seen.
The farmers call it a devil; the board calls it a bounty. Something has been killing livestock and travellers alike. Bring back proof it's dead.
The bounty is yours. The roads are a little safer tonight.
They'll be telling the story in the taverns tonight - and getting it wrong. Take the coin.
The board strikes the notice through with a heavy hand. One less monster on the roads.
You there! A bounty has been posted, and you look like a hunter.

template.name: Caravan Crossing

stage.name: The Caravan Master
stage.text: {caravan} waits at the edge of {place}. Find its master on your radar.

objective.dialog: The road ahead is thick with brigands and worse. We leave now, with you leading. Keep them off the wagon and we'll all live to see town.

stage.name: The Crossing
stage.text: Lead the wagon towards {dest}. When it stops, the ambushers come - beat them off.
The wagons creak into motion. Lead them towards {dest}, and keep your eyes on the treeline.

objective.startText: Hyah! Lead the way, we follow.
objective.arriveText: We're through! You've earned your pay.
objective.failText: The wagon is lost, and the cargo with it.

on.text: The caravan master whispers: the brigands answer to someone. The board will want to know.

template.text: Caravan Crossing
A caravan must cross dangerous land and no guard can be spared. Lead it from the wilds to the next town and keep the wagon in one piece.
The merchants' guild needs a blade to lead a wagon train through country the army won't patrol. The pay is honest; the road is not.
A caravan master is stranded at the edge of the wilds with a full load and no guards. He'll pay well to see his wagons to town.
The caravan made it through. The merchants pay what they promised, and a little more.
The wagons roll into town to cheers. The caravan master counts out your fee twice, just to be sure it's enough.
You left the caravan to its fate.
Adventurer! A caravan needs an escort, right now. Will you help?

template.name: Kidnapped: {hostage}

contact.dialog: You came! They dragged {hostage} off this very road - {gang}, by their colours. I counted five of them. The trail is fresh, but it won't stay that way for long.

stage.name: The Trail
stage.text: {hostage} was taken on the road in {place}. Find out where they went.
The watchman shows you where {hostage} was taken. The kidnappers didn't bother hiding their tracks - they don't expect anyone to follow.

on.text: The trail has gone cold. {hostage} is lost.

stage.name: The Hideout
stage.text: The trail ends at {gang}'s hideout. Clear it out before they move {hostage} again.

on.text: {gang} moved {hostage} to another hideout - and their leader is with them now!

stage.name: The Way Home
stage.text: {hostage} is free, but shaken. Lead them safely towards {dest}.
{hostage} clings to your arm. The road to {dest} is long, and {gang} will want them back.

objective.startText: Thank the gods... please, get me home.
objective.ambushText: They are coming back for me!
objective.arriveText: Home... I never thought I'd see it again.
objective.failText: {gang} took {hostage} back, and this time for good.

on.text: {hostage} heard their leader's name. The board will post a bounty.

template.text: Kidnapped!
{requester} begs for help: someone dear was dragged off the road by brigands. Follow their trail, free the captive and bring them home.
{requester} can barely speak: someone was dragged off the road by armed men, and the town watch has no one to send. Every hour counts.
A ransom note was nailed to the board this morning. {requester} doesn't trust the kidnappers to keep their word - and asks you to bring the captive back instead.
{hostage} is home, and a whole town owes you.
The town turns out to see {hostage} come home. {requester} presses your hand and won't let go.
With nobody left to follow the trail, {hostage} is lost.
Please, adventurer! They took someone - brigands, on the road! Help us!

template.name: Order for {requester}

stage.name: The Order
stage.text: Bring {goods} to a Notice Board for {requester}.

objective.name: lumps of cold iron
objective.text: If you can, bring cold iron from the {monster} in {place} too.

template.text: Blacksmith's Order
{requester} has more orders than materials. Bring what the forge needs - the grade you work with yourself - and be paid well above the shop price.
The forge roars again. {requester} pays in coin and in favours.

template.name: A Favour for {requester}

objective.text: Bring {goods} to a Notice Board for {requester}.
Carry {requester}'s letter to the Notice Board of {dest}.
Thin out the {monster} in {place} that trouble {requester}.

template.text: A Favour
{requester} needs a hand with something small. It won't take long, and they will remember it.
{requester} thanks you warmly.

template.name: Outbreak of {monster}

stage.name: The Surge
stage.text: The {monster} in {place} are multiplying. Trim them down before they spread!

on.text: The outbreak spreads, and an alpha leads it!

template.text: Outbreak
Outbreak! The {monster} in {place} are multiplying out of control. Hunters of level {level} or so, trim them down!
The outbreak in {place} has been trimmed down. Well fought!
The outbreak in {place} could not be stopped. The beasts scatter into the land.
The surge is broken. Everyone who fought shares the reward.

template.name: Hold the Line

stage.name: The Camp
stage.text: {captain}'s camp in {place} expects an attack. Report to the captain.

objective.dialog: Our scouts saw them gathering - too many for us alone. Stand by our banner. If it falls, the camp falls with it.

stage.name: The Assault
stage.text: Defend the banner through every wave, and break their leader.

on.text: The banner has fallen, and the camp with it.

template.text: Hold the Line
A camp in the wilds is about to be overrun. Its captain asks for anyone who can hold a line.
A frontier camp sent a rider at dawn: a warband is gathering, and the camp can't hold alone. Every sword counts.
The guard captain at a wilderness camp asks the board for volunteers. They expect an attack before nightfall.
The camp stands. {captain} salutes you.
The banner still flies. The soldiers beat their shields as you walk through the camp.
You left the camp to its fate.
The camp nearby is under attack! They need every blade - come quickly!

template.name: The Lost Expedition

contact.dialog: I was the last to leave the camp - they sent me back for supplies. When I returned, {expedition} was gone: the tents, the people, everything. Whatever happened to them, the traces start here.
contact.line: Hurry. If anyone is still alive out there...

stage.name: The Trail
stage.text: {expedition} vanished in {place}. Follow their traces.
The porter points to the last place he saw {expedition}. From here, you're on your own.

on.text: The trail is lost. {expedition} will never be found.

stage.name: The Survivor
stage.text: One of {expedition} is alive! Lead the survivor towards {dest}.

objective.startText: You found me... I can walk, if you lead.
objective.arriveText: Safe at last. The others... I'll tell the board everything.

on.text: The survivor speaks of a second camp, further out.

stage.name: The Culprit
stage.text: Nobody survived. Something lairs where the trail ends - {beast}. Slay it.

on.text: In its lair: a map of the expedition's route - and a second camp, further out.
{beast} has gone to ground.

template.text: The Lost Expedition
An expedition into the wilds has not come back. Find out what happened to them - and bring back anyone you can.
The Ivory Tower is offering a reward for news of an expedition that stopped sending reports a week ago. Whatever you find, they want to know.
An expedition's porter came back alone and half mad. The board wants someone to retrace their route and find out what happened.
You learned the expedition's fate. The board records your name.
The Ivory Tower's clerk takes your report in silence, then pays twice the posted reward.
You left the trail, and it has gone cold.
You have sharp eyes. An expedition went missing near here - will you look for them?

template.name: The Nests in {place}

contact.dialog: The beasts here breed faster than we can cull them. I found their nests nearby. Burn them, and I will keep the young ones off your back for as long as I can.
contact.line: Go! Before the next brood hatches.

stage.name: The Nests
stage.text: Nests are breeding {monster} in {place}. Stand next to each nest to burn it, while their brood fights back.
The ranger marks the nests on your map. Burn them one by one - the brood will defend them.

on.text: The nests are swarming, and their mother has come!

template.text: Monster Nests
The hunting grounds teem with more beasts every day: something is breeding them. Find the nests and burn them.
The rangers have counted three times as many beasts as last season. Something is breeding them, and the rangers want the nests burned.
The hunters' lodge posts a plea: the wilds are crawling, and the nests must go before the brood reaches the roads.
The nests are ash. The land can breathe again.
Smoke rises from the burnt nests. By next season, the land should be quieter.
The nests breed on without you.
All this slaughter has stirred the nests nearby. Someone has to burn them - you?

template.name: Urgent Courier

stage.name: The Package
stage.text: Carry the sealed package to the Notice Board of {dest} on foot. A teleport breaks the seal.

objective.teleportText: The seal shatters as you pass through the ether - the package is ruined.

template.text: Urgent Courier
A sealed package must reach another town, and it can't go through the gatekeepers - the seal breaks in the ether. Carry it on foot, and watch the roads.
The package arrives, seal unbroken. The recipient pays the courier's fee.
The package never arrived.

template.name: The Treasure Map

stage.name: X Marks the Spot
stage.text: The map shows a spot in {place}. Find it and search the ground.

objective.text: Find the spot the map marks in {place}.

on.text: The map's ink has run - the spot is lost.

stage.name: Digging
stage.text: You found the chest! Its old guardians are stirring. Keep them off it while it comes loose.

objective.startText: The lid creaks... something is coming!
objective.failText: The chest was smashed to splinters.

template.text: Treasure Map
Among the remains you find a torn map with a mark on it.
A torn map, old and stained, with an X drawn near the hunting grounds you know. Someone buried something there - and didn't come back for it.
The old chest holds coin and more. Whoever buried it won't miss it.
The map crumbles to dust in your pack.

template.name: Manhunt: {fugitive}

contact.dialog: {fugitive} slipped past our patrol here last night and left a guard bleeding in the ditch. Someone saw them heading out into the wilds. They fight like an adventurer - don't let them pick the ground.

stage.name: Word on the Street
stage.text: {fugitive} was last seen in {place}. Follow the trail.
The marshal shows you where {fugitive} was last seen. They are careful, but not careful enough.

on.text: The trail has gone cold. {fugitive} got away.

stage.name: The Arrest
stage.text: {fugitive} hides ahead. They fight like any adventurer - be ready.

objective.title: {fugitive}
objective.revealText: {fugitive}: You should have stayed in town!
objective.fleeText: {fugitive} slipped away again! Follow the radar.

on.text: {fugitive} slipped away to a new hiding place!

template.text: Manhunt
A deserter turned murderer hides in the wilds. The board wants them stopped. They fight like an adventurer, and they won't come quietly. Killing them is lawful: no karma.
A deserter turned highwayman has killed three people this month. The magistrate wants them brought to justice - in chains or otherwise. No karma for the deed.
Wanted posters with {fugitive}'s face are nailed to every post. A marshal in the wilds has picked up the trail and needs a capable hand.
Justice is done. The board pays the bounty.
The magistrate signs the warrant closed. The roads are safer for it.
With nobody on the trail, the fugitive is long gone.

template.name: Corrupted Ground in {place}

contact.dialog: Can you smell it? The land here is sick. Someone planted totems that poison the soil and drive the beasts mad. Cleanse them - I will show you where the rot is thickest.
contact.line: May the land remember your kindness.

stage.name: The Taint
stage.text: Totems in {place} are poisoning the land and the beasts. Stand next to each one to cleanse it.

objective.nestText: Black ooze seeps from the totem. Stand next to it to cleanse it.
objective.swarmText: The corruption fights back - its heart has awoken!
objective.motherSlainText: The heart of the corruption is destroyed!

on.text: The corruption spreads faster!

template.text: Corrupted Ground
Something has tainted a hunting ground: the beasts there are sick and savage. Find the corrupted totems and cleanse them.
A druid of the grove sends word: something is poisoning the land, and the beasts have gone mad with it. The grove can't cleanse it alone.
Livestock is dying and the wells taste of rot. The trail of the sickness leads into the wilds, to totems no honest hand planted.
The land is clean again. The beasts calm down.
The corruption spreads unchecked.

template.name: Tracking {beast}

contact.dialog: I have tracked {beast} for three seasons, and it has made a fool of me every time. Its tracks are fresh today, but my knees won't carry me any more. Yours will.
contact.line: Take it down clean. It deserves that much.

stage.name: The Tracks
stage.text: {beast} was sighted in {place}. Follow its tracks.
The old hunter points out the first print, pressed deep into the mud. {beast} passed here, not long ago.

on.text: The tracks are washed away. {beast} is gone.

stage.name: The Beast
stage.text: The tracks end ahead. {beast} is there - strong, and wary.

on.text: {beast} has fled deeper into the wilds!

template.text: Rare Beast
A beast of legend has been seen: hunters have tried and failed to take it. Follow its tracks and bring it down.
An old hunter swears he has finally found the tracks of the beast he has chased for years. He's too old for the kill. You aren't.
The hunters' guild has a standing prize for this one: many have tried, and the beast is still out there. The tracks are fresh today.
You took the beast of legend. Hunters will talk about this.

template.name: Intercept {gang}

contact.dialog: {gang} move their goods through here today - I have watched them for a week. They set out as soon as you give the word, and they won't wait for anyone. Catch their boss before they reach the buyers.

stage.name: The Interception
stage.text: {gang} are moving contraband through the land in {place}. Catch them and break their boss before they reach {meeting}.

objective.revealText: The merchants throw off their cloaks - it's {gang}!
objective.killText: The boss is down - the contraband is seized!
objective.arriveText: {gang} reached their buyers in {meeting} and vanished. Too late.

template.text: Smuggler Interception
Smugglers move goods through the wilds under the guards' noses. The board knows their route - not for how long. Catch them on the move.
An informant knows exactly when the smugglers move their next load - but only today. Catch them on the road before they reach their buyers.
Contraband has been slipping past the patrols for weeks. The board has bought a name and a route. Be there when they set out.
The contraband is seized and the board pays a share of it.
The smugglers got through.

template.name: The Lost Child: {child}

contact.dialog: We've been calling for {child} since noon. The little one was playing near here, and then... nothing. Help us look - and be gentle when you find them, they scare easily.

stage.name: The Search
stage.text: {child} wandered off in {place}. Look for signs of where they went.
The searchers spread out. You take the trail nobody else has checked yet.

on.text: Night falls, and {child} is still out there. Others will keep looking.

stage.name: The Way Home
stage.text: You found {child}! Lead them home to {town} - and don't run ahead, or they'll wander off again.

objective.failText: {child} ran off in fright and is lost again.

template.text: The Lost Child
{requester} is beside themselves: a child wandered off into the wilds. Find them and bring them home - gently.
{requester} is pale with worry: a child slipped away to play in the wilds and hasn't come back. The searchers need help before nightfall.
A child's gone missing on the edge of the wilds. {requester} begs anyone with a sword to join the search.
{child} is home safe. {requester} can't thank you enough.
Others will have to find the child now.

template.name: Fish for {requester}
template.text: Fisherman's Request
{requester} has an order to fill and too few hands. Catch fish in the waters near {town}. A few caught with a night lure would fetch a better price.
{requester} weighs the catch and nods: a fair day's work.

template.name: Scout the Frontier

contact.dialog: You're the one the board sent? Good. The vantage points are marked on your map. Keep low and keep quiet - if anything out there sees you, the whole report is worthless.

stage.name: The Vantage Points
stage.text: Reach the vantage points in {place} and watch from each (sitting helps). If anything sees you and attacks, the scouting is ruined.

objective.seenText: You were seen - the enemy knows they are watched now. The scouting is ruined.
objective.text: Watch from the vantage points in {place} without being seen.

template.text: Scout the Frontier
The board needs eyes on the frontier: who camps where, and how many. Watch from the high places - and don't get caught.
Your report is worth its weight in gold.

template.name: The Levy of {castle}

objective.text: Clear the {monster} from the lands of {castle}, in {place}.

template.text: Lord's Levy
{lord}, lord of {castle}, posts a levy: the beasts of the castle's lands must be thinned, and the castle pays half again on top of the board's reward, from its own treasury.
{lord} is pleased with your work.

template.name: Race for {target}

contact.dialog: You read the notice too? So did half the taverns. {target} was sighted near here not an hour ago, and a rival party set out just before you arrived. Move!
contact.line: Run! They have a head start.

stage.name: The Sighting
stage.text: {target} was seen in {place}. Others read the same notice - be quick.

on.text: The rivals got there first.

stage.name: The Race
stage.text: {target} is ahead - and so are rival adventurers who want the bounty for themselves.

objective.title: Rival Adventurer
objective.revealText: Rival adventurers! They want the bounty too!

on.text: The rivals took {target} while you dawdled.

template.text: Rival Adventurers
A rich bounty is posted, and you are not the only one who read it. A rival party is already on its way. Get there first.
The bounty is yours, and the rivals go home empty-handed.

template.name: Rifts in {place}

contact.dialog: The air itself is torn here. Rifts keep opening, and things from far-off lands crawl through them. I can show you how to seal them, but I can't hold them back alone.
contact.line: Seal them fast - they widen by the minute.

stage.name: The Rifts
stage.text: Rifts have torn open in {place}, and beasts of {foreignLand} crawl through. Stand next to each rift to seal it.

objective.nestText: The air tears open here, and things from far away crawl through. Stand next to the rift to seal it.
objective.swarmText: The rifts widen - a warden comes through!

on.text: The rifts are widening!

template.text: Rift Closing
Strange rifts are opening in the land, and creatures from far-off places come through them. Seal the rifts before the land is overrun.
The rifts are sealed. The strange creatures fade away.
The rifts stay open.

template.name: Herbs for {requester}

contact.dialog: The fever herbs grow wild around here, but they wilt soon after they are picked. Gather them and run them back to {town} as fast as you can. I'll show you which ones to take.

objective.trapText: A snake was coiled among the roots!
objective.name: fever herbs
objective.nodeText: A fever herb. Careful - the roots are fragile.

on.text: The fever has run its course without the herbs.

objective.text: Hurry the herbs to {requester} in {town} before they wilt.

on.text: The herbs have wilted. Too late.

template.text: Herbalist's Plague
A fever is spreading through the town, and {requester} needs fresh herbs from the wilds - fast, before they wilt.
The fever breaks. {requester} weeps with relief.

template.name: The Night Watch of {town}

stage.name: The Watch
stage.text: Walk the watch posts around {town} and check each one. Things come out of the dark at night.

on.text: The watch is over, and you didn't finish your round.

template.text: Night Watch
The town watch is short of hands tonight. Walk the posts around the town until your round is done. Only at night - the watch ends at dawn.
Your round is done and the town sleeps safe.
Dawn breaks before your round is done. The day watch takes over.
You left your post.

template.name: Guild Contract

contact.dialog: The guild's contract is posted here, and the work is close by. Do this one right and there may be another. Ready to hear the terms?
contact.line: Then get to work. The guild is watching.

on.text: The guild has another contract for you, if you want it.
The guild has another contract for you, if you want it.

objective.text: Follow the trail the guild marked in {place}.

on.text: The guild has another contract for you, if you want it.
The guild has another contract for you, if you want it.

template.text: Guild Contract
The adventurers' guild has contracts for reliable hands. Finish one and they may offer the next; five in a row and the guild names you its champion. You can stop whenever you like.
The adventurers' guild has posted a contract with a fair price and no questions. Do it well, and the guild has more where that came from.
A guild factor is handing out contracts in the field today. Reliable hands are rewarded; the best earn a name.
The guild pays and notes your name.
The guild gives the contract to someone else.

template.name: Live Capture: {beast}

contact.dialog: The Beast Farm pays a fortune for {beast} - alive. Dead, it's just meat. Wear it down until it can't fight, then bind it before it gets its breath back. Its tracks start here.

stage.name: The Tracks
stage.text: Beastmaster Rolf shows you the first tracks of {beast}. Follow them.
The tracks of {beast} lead away from the farm's camp. Follow them, quietly.

on.text: The tracks are gone. {beast} is lost to the wilds.

stage.name: The Capture
stage.text: {beast} is ahead. Wear it down - it won't die, but it fights back - and bind it when it falls.

objective.title: {beast}
objective.subdueText: {beast} sinks to the ground, exhausted. Bind it - quickly!
objective.captureText: {beast} is bound and ready for the farm!
objective.breakText: {beast} shakes off the ropes and charges!

on.text: {beast} has fled deeper into the wilds!

template.text: Live Capture
The Beast Farm will pay a fortune for a rare beast brought in alive - and nothing for a carcass. Wear it down, bind it, and keep your blade from finishing the job.
A beastmaster of the Beast Farm wants {beast} for the breeding pens. Alive, unharmed enough to breed. The pay is better than any bounty.
{beast} snorts in its ropes as the beastmaster's handlers lead it away. The farm pays as promised.
The Beast Farm has a new prize, and you have the farm's gold.
With nobody holding the ropes, {beast} is long gone.

template.name: Alive: the Leader of {gang}

contact.dialog: The magistrate wants the leader of {gang} alive - a dead man can't name his partners. He hides in the wilds with his best blades around him. Deal with them, beat him down, and bind him. The trail starts here.
contact.line: Remember: alive. The magistrate was very clear.

stage.name: The Hideout
stage.text: The marshal points out the trail of {gang}. It leads to their leader's hideout.

on.text: {gang} moved their hideout. The trail is cold.

stage.name: The Arrest
stage.text: The leader of {gang} is ahead, with his best blades. Cut down the guards, beat him down and bind him - alive.

objective.title: Leader of {gang}
objective.subdueText: The leader of {gang} drops his blade: "Enough! Enough..." Bind him!
objective.guardedText: His blades are still standing - deal with them first!
objective.captureText: The leader of {gang} is in chains!
objective.breakText: He grabs his blade and fights on!
objective.fleeText: The leader of {gang} slipped away! Follow the radar.

objective.text: Thin out the {monster} around the hideout.

on.text: The leader of {gang} got away to another hideout!

template.text: Alive or Not at All
The magistrate posts a bounty on the leader of {gang} - payable only if he is brought in alive. His partners are the real prize, and only he can name them.
The town guard needs the leader of {gang} in chains, not in a grave. Beat him, bind him, bring him in. The marshal waits in the wilds.
The leader of {gang} is marched into the cells, already bargaining. The magistrate pays in full.
In chains and talking: by nightfall, half of {gang} will be in the cells with him.
With nobody holding him, the leader of {gang} walked away.
